name: Verdant Expanse of Yrthak
description: In the depths of Sindile Forest lies a portal to Yrthak, a plane of existence unfathomable to ordinary travelers. Those who cross the portal find themselves in a dense, sweltering jungle where the air is heavy with humidity and filled with the constant noise of exotic birds. This world, largely uncharted by the Tanareans, is viewed by scholars and explorers alike as a blend of danger and wonder. The jungle of Yrthak is home to a myriad of lizard creatures, ranging from aquatic plesiosaurs to herds of triceratops and from the terrifying tyrannosaurs that hunt the wilderness to the Primedraconids - enormous, bestial draconic creatures that fly over the forest, hunting purely by instinct, always hungry. Amidst this savage splendor, ancient temples lie hidden in the forest. Harboring the secrets of the gods they honor and magical artifacts of untold power, these stone structures were erected by a unique species of lizardfolk inhabiting Yrthak. While some temples are old and abandoned, filled with traps, and protected by sorcery, others are actively used for sacred rites. The lizardfolk in the region the Tanareans explored so far can be divided into three groups. The Servants of Azskah. Calm and tradition-bound, these lizardfolk are the self-appointed guardians of Yrthak. They worship Azskah, a colossal winged serpent revered as the creator of their world. Their society, structured and adhering to strict traditional laws, fervently opposes any external intrusion, especially from the Tanareans, fearing they will bring the corruption of the Ungods. In their eyes, every outsider is a potential harbinger of desecration. Despite their desire to seal off their realm, the secrets to close the portal elude them. Distinguished by their use of feathers as indumentary, with colors signifying their societal roles, they are led by High Priests who answer to the Azskahnian King, a leader empowered by their serpent deity. Azskah, a god of healing, protection, and vengeance, instills in his followers the importance of life, mutual protection, and retribution for those who harm them. This often leads them to make incursions against the Spawns of Ukka for hunting Azskahnians. The temples of Azskah are rumored to contain untold riches, magical items that can rejuvenate individuals, and even scales said to be from Azskah himself, capable of reviving the dead. The Spawns of Ukka. Warriors of raw, untamed ferocity, these lizardfolk live by the hunt. In the dense undergrowth, they pursue their prey with a zeal bordering on fanaticism. Devotees of Ukka, the Scaled Sorceress, they believe her to be the first of their species, the mother of all, and the giver of all magic. They sacrifice non-believing lizardfolk to return their spirits to “Greatmother Ukka,” allowing them to be reborn from their eggs as purified believers. Sacrificial rituals are also made using powerful hunted creatures or Tanarean explorers, demonstrating Ukka’s power. They hunt Azskahnians and Jungle Walkers, believing those who stray from Ukka are misguided. They particularly detest Azskah and its priests, seeing their deity as a devilish snake attempting to steal Ukka’s offspring, just as snakes sneak on their eggs. While the Ukkanians may hunt explorers in Yrthak, they sometimes strike deals with adventurers, trading information and the locations of Azskah’s secret temples in exchange for help eliminating more of the serpent deity’s servants. The Jungle Walkers. These nomadic druids embody the spirit of Yrthak’s wilderness. Harmonizing with nature, they roam the jungle as a nomadic society, collecting and hunting as necessary while blending with the fantastic nature around them. Unlike their kin, they welcome outsiders, viewing the looming threat of the Ungods as a universal peril that will endanger their world if not addressed. They see the Servants of Azskah as overly rigid and the Spawns of Ukka as corrupted, deviating from the natural balance they cherish. Open to trade with explorers and adventurers, they generally respect Azskahnians and are often in search of aid to rescue captured Walkers destined for sacrifice to Ukka. Adventurers venturing into Yrthak are drawn into a world where the allure of ancient mysteries and a constant struggle for dominance create a perpetual survival challenge. The jungle, teeming with dangerous creatures, cursed temples, and hunting lizardfolk, offers dangers and opportunities for those brave enough to explore this uncharted world.
